title: Dad Kern Standing in Garden, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length vintage outdoor snapshot featuring an older gentleman identified as 'Dad Kern' on the top margin. Dressed sharply in a three-piece suit, tie, and fedora hat while smoking a cigar, he poses in front of a white wooden garden trellis with rose vines beside a clapboard home, reflecting early 20th-century fashion and domestic life in America.
